jobs.title: Welcome Agent Intern - W VERBIER
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCITING CHANCE TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As a Welcome Talent Intern, you will be at the heart of daily departmental operations, serving as the ambassador for the W spirit, concept, and brand standards. Your mission? Greet our guests with enthusiasm and professionalism from check-in to check-out, creating a WOW effect at every step and anticipating their needs with finesse.

Your innate passion for our brand will enable you to advise guests on hotel services, stay conditions, and any other inquiries, ensuring an unforgettable experience.

You will also handle communication with guests via phone and email, and relay essential information to various hotel departments. Verifying services, invoicing, processing payments by credit cards, and monitoring deferred payments will also be part of your responsibilities.

PROFILE

Fluent in French and English; proficiency in a third language is a plus.

Highly motivated and passionate about the realms of taste, sound, body, scene, and stance.

Attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB

Visita in diretta qui: W VERBIER Home

Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere!

Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione.

UN'ESCITAZIONE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W

In qualità di Welcome Talent Intern, sarete al centro delle operazioni dipartimentali quotidiane, servendo come ambasciatore per lo spirito, il concetto e gli standard del marchio W. La tua missione? Saluta i nostri ospiti con entusiasmo e professionalità dal check-in al check-out, creando un effetto WOW ad ogni passo e anticipando le loro esigenze con finesse.

La vostra innata passione per il nostro marchio vi permetterà di consigliare gli ospiti sui servizi alberghieri, sulle condizioni di soggiorno e su qualsiasi altra richiesta, garantendo un'esperienza indimenticabile.

Potrai anche gestire la comunicazione con gli ospiti via telefono e email, e relay informazioni essenziali per vari dipartimenti di hotel. I servizi di verifica, fatturazione, elaborazione dei pagamenti tramite carte di credito e monitoraggio dei pagamenti differiti saranno anche parte delle vostre responsabilità.

PROFESSIONALE

Fluente in francese e inglese; la competenza in una terza lingua è un plus.

Altamente motivato e appassionato dei regni di gusto, suono, corpo, scena e posizione.

Attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno di offrire esperienze eccezionali ai clienti.

A causa delle restrizioni di visto solo i candidati provenienti dalla Svizzera e dall'Unione Europea possono essere considerati.

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

BESCHREIBUNG

Besuchen Sie hier live : W VERBIER Home

Werde ein W Talent und verkörpere die W Art of Living!

Als „Talent sind Sie die Essenz von W für unsere Gäste. Sie bringen eine spielerische, warme und einladende Note, die den Unterschied in unseren W Hotels macht. Du bist einzigartig, leidenschaftlich und deine Persönlichkeit scheint in jeder Interaktion durch.

GELTENDE ANGABEN ZUM W-VERBIER-TEAM

Als Welcome Talent Intern stehen Sie im Mittelpunkt des täglichen Abteilungsbetriebs und sind Botschafter für W Spirit, Concept und Markenstandards. Ihre Mission? Begrüßen Sie unsere Gäste mit Begeisterung und Professionalität vom Check-in bis zum Check-out, schaffen Sie bei jedem Schritt einen WOW-Effekt und antizipieren Sie ihre Bedürfnisse mit Finesse.

Ihre angeborene Leidenschaft für unsere Marke wird es Ihnen ermöglichen, Gäste zu Hoteldienstleistungen, Aufenthaltsbedingungen und anderen Anfragen zu beraten und so ein unvergessliches Erlebnis zu gewährleisten.

Sie werden auch die Kommunikation mit den Gästen per Telefon und E-Mail übernehmen und wichtige Informationen an verschiedene Hotelabteilungen weitergeben. Die Überprüfung von Dienstleistungen, die Rechnungsstellung, die Verarbeitung von Zahlungen mit Kreditkarten und die Überwachung von aufgeschobenen Zahlungen gehören ebenfalls zu Ihren
• Aufgaben.

PROFIL

Fließend Französisch und Englisch; Kenntnisse in einer dritten Sprache ist ein Plus.

Hoch motiviert und leidenschaftlich über die Bereiche Geschmack, Klang, Körper, Szene und Haltung.

Aufmerksamkeit für Details und Engagement für außergewöhnliche Kundenerlebnisse.

Aufgrund von Visabeschränkungen können nur Bewerber aus der Schweiz und der Europäischen Union berücksichtigt werden.

Bei Marriott International sind wir bestrebt, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein, alle willkommen zu heißen und Zugang zu Chancen zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv ein Umfeld, in dem die einzigartigen Hintergründe unserer Mitarbeiter geschätzt und gefeiert werden. Unsere größte Stärke liegt in der reichen Mischung aus Kultur, Talent und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, Veteranenstatus oder einer anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Grundlage.

Die Mission von W Hotels ist es, Curiosity zu entzünden, Welten zu erweitern. Wir sind ein Ort, um das Leben zu erleben. Wir sind hier, um Türen und offene Köpfe zu öffnen. Wir werden ständig von neuen Gesichtern und neuen Erfahrungen inspiriert. Ein abgestimmter, up-for-anything-geist ist in unserem kern und hat uns dafür bekannt gemacht, die normen des luxus auf der ganzen welt neu zu erfinden. Was auch immer unsere Kultur und Servicephilosophie ist, die die Leidenschaften unserer Gäste zum Leben erweckt. Wenn Sie originell, innovativ und immer auf die Zukunft des Möglichen ausgerichtet sind, willkommen in W Hotels. Wenn Sie W Hotels beitreten, schließen Sie sich einem Markenportfolio mit Marriott International an. Seien Sie dort, wo Sie Ihre beste Arbeit leisten, Ihren Zweck beginnen, zu einem erstaunlichen globalen Team gehören und die beste Version von Ihnen werden können.

Nous sommes constamment inspirés par de nouveaux visages et de nouvelles expériences. Un esprit à la hauteur de tout est à notre cœur et nous a rendus réputés pour avoir réinventé les normes du luxe à travers le monde. Quoi qu'il en soit, notre philosophie de la culture et du service apporte à nos hôtes des passions. Si vous êtes original, innovant et toujours regardant vers l'avenir de ce qui est possible, bienvenue à W Hotels. En rejoignant W Hotels, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. Soyez là où vous pouvez faire votre meilleur travail, commencer votre objectif, appartenir à une équipe mondiale incroyable, et devenir la meilleure version de vous.

jobs.description:
PLEASE NOTE:

• ONLY SWISS OR EU CITIZENS OR B/C PERMIT HOLDERS

• FLUENT THAI

POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
 Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of "Wonderful Hospitality. Always." by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that's synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you're happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand's namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you'll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That's The JW Treatment. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

SOMMARIO DELLA POSIZIONE

I nostri lavori non sono solo di mettere cibo sul tavolo che i nostri ospiti potranno godere fino a quando non chiedono il loro conto. Invece, vogliamo costruire un'esperienza che è memorabile e unica. con cibo e bevande sul lato. I nostri esperti del servizio ospiti prendono l'iniziativa e forniscono una vasta gamma di servizi per assicurarsi che gli ospiti godano il loro pasto. Sia che si allestiscano tavoli, comunicare con la cucina, interagire e servire gli ospiti, o pulire aree di lavoro e forniture, il Servizio clienti Expert fa le transazioni si sentono come parte dell'esperienza.

Non importa in quale posizione ti trovi, ci sono alcune cose che sono fondamentali per il successo. creazione di un posto di lavoro sicuro, seguendo le politiche e le procedure aziendali, il rispetto degli standard di qualità, e garantire il vostro aspetto uniforme, personale, e le comunicazioni sono professionali.

Gli esperti del servizio ospiti saranno in piedi e si muoveranno (stare, sedersi, o camminare per un lungo periodo; spostarsi su superfici inclinate, irregolari, o scivolose), la gestione del menu (lettura e verifica visiva informazioni), e prendere un approccio pratico per lavorare (muovere, sollevare, portare, spingere, tirare, e mettere oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 25 libbre senza assistenza e 50 libbre con assistenza; raggiungere in alto e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegare, torsione, tirare, e stooping).

Fare bene tutte queste cose (e altri compiti di lavoro ragionevoli come richiesto) è fondamentale per gli esperti del servizio ospiti. per farlo bene per i nostri ospiti e la nostra attività ogni volta.

QUALIFICHE PREFERITE Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D. Esperienza lavorativa correlata: meno di 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa correlata. Esperienza di vigilanza: nessuna esperienza di supervisione. Licenza o certificazione: Nessuno

In Marriott International, ci impegniamo a essere un datore di lavoro per le pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente dove vengono apprezzati e celebrati i background unici dei nostri associati. La nostra forza maggiore è la ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su qualsiasi base protetta, inclusa disabilità, stato di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

Marriott Hotels si sforza di raggiungere i 142 luoghi dove l'arte dell'ospitalità è sempre innovativa, mantenendo il comfort dell'oh-so-familiar in tutto il mondo. Come host con Marriott Hotels, vi aiuterà a mantenere la promessa di "Wonderful Hospitality. Sempre." offrendo un servizio attento, accorto e lungimirante che sostiene e costruisce su questa eredità vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. Unendo Marriott Hotels, unitevi a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International.

Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartenere a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi. JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di lusso di Marriott International e consiste di più di 100 belle proprietà in città gateway e località resort distintive in tutto il mondo. JW crede che i nostri associati vengono prima. Perché se siete felici, i nostri ospiti saranno felici. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi, e portare avanti l'eredità del marchio omonimo e fondatore dell'azienda, J.Willard Marriott.

I nostri hotel offrono un'esperienza lavorativa diversa da qualsiasi altra, dove farai parte di una comunità e godrai di un vero camaraderie con un gruppo di collaboratori diversi. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e soprattutto, un luogo dove potrai perseguire le tue passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti inizia eccezionalmente dal modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. Questo è il trattamento JW. Unendoti a JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International.

Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartenere a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

BITTE BEACHTEN:

• NUR SCHWEISSE ODER EU-BÜRGER ODER B/C-PERMIT-HABER

• FLUENTE THAI

ZUSAMMENFASSUNG DER STANDPUNKTE

Unsere Jobs sind nicht nur darum, Essen auf den Tisch zu legen, die unsere Gäste genießen, bis sie ihre Rechnung verlangen. Stattdessen wollen wir ein unvergessliches und einzigartiges Erlebnis aufbauen – mit Speisen und Getränken auf der Seite. Unsere Guest Service Experten ergreifen die Initiative und bieten eine breite Palette von Dienstleistungen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Gäste ihr Essen genießen. Ob Tische setzen, mit der Küche kommunizieren, interagieren und Gäste bedienen, oder Arbeitsbereiche und Zubehör reinigen, der Guest Service Expert lässt Transaktionen wie ein Teil der Erfahrung fühlen.

Egal in welcher Position Sie sich befinden, es gibt einige Dinge, die für den Erfolg entscheidend sind: die Schaffung eines sicheren Arbeitsplatzes, die Einhaltung von Unternehmenspolitiken und -verfahren, die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards und die Sicherstellung Ihres einheitlichen, persönlichen Aussehens und Ihrer Kommunikation sind professionell.

The Welcome Agent & Spa therapist administers professional massage and body treatments to the guests. Come "Talent", tu rappresenti lo stile di vita W ai nostri ospiti. Sei l'anima dietro il marchio e lo porti alla vita. W Talents sono unici come il marchio stesso e sono personalmente impegnati da un punto di vista lifestyle al caldo, spiritoso, accogliente ambiente del marchio.

UN'ESCITAZIONE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W

W Hotels ridefinisce il concetto di destinazione SPA, offrendo un luogo dove l'atmosfera è una decompressione e dove i trattamenti sono sempre un piacere.

In qualità di Head Therapist/Spa Supervisor , supporterai il Direttore Spa nei suoi compiti quotidiani.

Un vero camaleonte del mondo della spa e del benessere, sarete coinvolti nella formazione Talent, supervisionando la squadra, gestendo gli orari e aumentando il reddito della spa.

Sarete anche responsabili per ricevere e ottimizzare le slot di prenotazione.

Stimolerete la curiosità dei clienti sui trattamenti della Spa e sui prodotti à la carte e vi posizionate come venditore.

Sarete responsabili di accogliere i clienti e prendere appuntamenti in linea con gli standard W Verbier, preparare la sala di trattamento e mantenere pulita la spa e le camere.

PROFESSIONALE

In uscita, allegro, un buon ascoltatore, disponibile e disponibile.

Fluente in francese e inglese

Godetevi il lavoro in un team internazionale e avventuroso

Ottima presentazione e rappresentazione dell'immagine del marchio W

BTS/ CFC Estetica / cosmetici o equivalente / Certificazione in massaggio tailandese

Sei molto motivato.

Essere orientati al dettaglio e avere una passione per dare agli ospiti un'esperienza eccezionale.

Interesse reale nei mondi del gusto, del suono, del corpo, della scena e della posizione

La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SUMMARIO POSIZIONE

I nostri lavori non sono solo di dare agli ospiti un check-in e check-out fluidi. Invece, vogliamo costruire e sperimentare che è memorabile e unico. I nostri esperti dell'esperienza ospite prendono l'iniziativa di fornire una vasta gamma di servizi che guidano gli ospiti attraverso il loro soggiorno. Essi sono autorizzati a muoversi sul loro spazio e fare ciò che deve essere fatto. Sia che si tratti di elaborare esigenze operative, di rispondere alle richieste degli ospiti, di compilare report o di condividere i punti salienti dell'area locale, il Guest Experience Expert fa sentire le transazioni come parte dell'esperienza.

Non importa quale sia la posizione in cui ti trovi, ci sono alcune cose che sono critiche al successo – creando un luogo di lavoro sicuro, seguendo politiche e procedure aziendali, mantenendo la riservatezza, proteggendo i beni aziendali, rispettando gli standard di qualità, e garantendo la tua uniforme, aspetto personale e le comunicazioni sono professionali. Gli esperti dell'esperienza degli ospiti saranno in piedi e si muoveranno (stand, sit, o camminare per un tempo prolungato) e prendendo un approccio pratico al lavoro (move, ascensore, trasportare, spingere, tirare, e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 10 sterline senza assistenza). Fare tutte queste cose bene (e altri ragionevoli doveri di lavoro come richiesto) è fondamentale per gli esperti di esperienza degli ospiti – per ottenere il diritto per i nostri ospiti e il nostro business ogni volta.

QUALIFICA PREFERRATA
• Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D.
• Esperienza di lavoro correlata: nessuna esperienza di lavoro correlata.
• Esperienza di supervisione: Nessuna esperienza di supervisione.
• Licenza o Certificazione: Nessuno

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

In oltre 100 strutture premiate in tutto il mondo, The Ritz-Carlton Signore e Signori creano esperienze così eccezionali che a lungo dopo un ospite soggiorna con noi, l'esperienza rimane con loro. Attrarre i migliori professionisti dell’ospitalità del mondo che curano i ricordi per tutta la vita, crediamo che tutti ci riescano quando hanno il potere di essere creativi, riflessivi e compassionevoli.
Ogni giorno, abbiamo stabilito lo standard per il servizio di lusso raro e speciale in tutto il mondo e ci orgogliosi di fornire l'eccellenza nella cura e nel comfort dei nostri ospiti.

Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di garantire che i “Gold Standards” di The Ritz-Carlton vengano consegnati con gentilezza e con pensiero ogni giorno. Gli Gold Standards sono la base di The Ritz-Carlton e sono ciò che ci guida ogni giorno per essere meglio del prossimo. E 'questa fondazione e la nostra convinzione che la nostra cultura spinge il successo con cui The Ritz Carlton ha guadagnato la reputazione di leader di marca globale nell'ospitalità di lusso. Nell'ambito del nostro team, imparerai ed esemplificherai gli standard dell'oro, come la nostra promessa dei dipendenti, il credo e i nostri valori di servizio. E la nostra promessa è che offriamo la possibilità di essere orgogliosi del lavoro che fate e con cui lavorate.

Nell'unione con The Ritz-Carlton, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

ZUSAMMENFASSUNG DER POSITION

Bei unseren Jobs geht es nicht nur darum, den Gästen einen reibungslosen Check-in und Check-out zu bieten. Stattdessen wollen wir bauen und erleben, die unvergesslich und einzigartig ist. Unsere Guest Experience-Experten ergreifen die Initiative, um eine breite Palette von Dienstleistungen zu bieten, die die Gäste durch ihren gesamten Aufenthalt führen. Sie sind befugt, sich in ihrem raum zu bewegen und zu tun, was getan werden muss. Ob die Verarbeitung operativer Bedürfnisse, die Bearbeitung von Gästeanfragen, das Ausfüllen von Berichten oder das Teilen der Highlights des lokalen Bereichs, der Guest Experience Expert lässt Transaktionen als Teil der Erfahrung erscheinen.

Unabhängig davon, in welcher Position Sie sich befinden, gibt es einige Dinge, die für den Erfolg entscheidend sind - die Schaffung eines sicheren Arbeitsplatzes, die Einhaltung von Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren, die Wahrung der Vertraulichkeit, der Schutz der Vermögenswerte des Unternehmens, die Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards und die Gewährleistung Ihres einheitlichen, persönlichen Aussehens und Ihrer professionellen Kommunikation. Experten für Gästeerfahrungen sind auf den Beinen und bewegen sich (stehen, sitzen oder gehen für längere Zeit) und gehen praktisch an die Arbeit heran (Bewegung, Heben, Tragen, Schieben, Ziehen und Platzieren von Objekten mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 10 Pfund ohne Hilfe). All diese Dinge gut zu machen (und andere angemessene Aufgaben, wie gewünscht) ist für Guest Experience Experten von entscheidender Bedeutung - um es jedes Mal für unsere Gäste und unser Geschäft richtig zu machen.

• Ausbildung: High-School-Diplom oder GED gleichwertig.
• Verwandte Arbeitserfahrung: Keine verwandte Arbeitserfahrung.

jobs.title: Kitchen intern - W Verbier
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

We are looking for a highly motivated, enthusiastic, skilled Kitchen Intern to rock the kitchen scene! As a Kitchen Intern you will prepare food items for customers using a quality predetermined method in a timely and consistent manner.

Set up station with predetermined mise en place required to service all outlets and banquet functions.

Practice sanitation and safety daily to ensure the total customer satisfaction.

We have one main kitchen for all our venues : Brasserie 1519, Living Room, In room Dining, Banqueting & Breakfast.

PROFILE

Must be currently enrolled in a Hospitality school / Culinary school (renown by CCNT)

You are highly motivated

Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.title: Global Managing Director, Lefay
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Global Managing Director – Lefay Wellness Resorts provides strategic and enterprise leadership for the long-term stewardship, evolution, and global expansion of Lefay, a luxury wellness resort brand. This role is accountable for safeguarding the brand’s founding philosophy and proprietary wellness methodologies while driving sustainable growth, financial performance, and asset value creation through a disciplined, asset-light model.

Operating within a Joint Venture structure, the Managing Director partners closely with the Founders, Joint Venture Board, and Marriott’s global and regional functions to ensure the brand’s standards, operating model, and development pipeline are scalable, compliant, and aligned across markets. The role requires strong governance, stakeholder alignment, and the ability to lead effectively within a complex, matrixed organization.

Leveraging a deliberately lean organizational model, the Managing Director provides leadership and strategic oversight across properties, including influence over General Manager selection and performance, while ensuring alignment to Lefay’s luxury positioning, wellness credibility, and guest experience standards.

The position reports to the JV Board.

Scope

• Location: Switzerland

• This position will be required to travel frequently

Key Responsibilities

• Protect and scale Lefay’s wellness philosophy and proprietary methodologies by codifying and embedding the brand’s integrated wellness framework, encompassing its scientific underpinnings, treatment methodologies, programme design, and translation into consistent guest experiences across diverse global markets.

• Partner with ownership and development teams to grow a disciplined global pipeline by identifying and evaluating target markets and opportunities, encompassing feasibility assessment, deal structuring support, and alignment of all new developments to Lefay’s brand positioning, design philosophy, and financial performance expectations.

• Drive alignment across Marriott, the Joint Venture Board, owners, and brand stakeholders by establishing and leading governance and decision-making frameworks, encompassing structured forums, clear roles and accountabilities, and consistent communication to enable prioritisation and execution within a complex matrixed environment.

• Oversee brand standards, guest experience, and wellness programming globally by defining and governing Lefay’s end-to-end brand framework, encompassing brand pillars and foundational elements, tone of voice and positioning, and the full guest journey from pre-arrival through post-stay engagement.

• Serve as the primary interface with the Joint Venture Board of Directors by leading strategic engagement and performance reporting, encompassing regular updates on financial performance, development pipeline progress, brand evolution, and alignment on long-term strategic priorities.

• Lead governance processes including strategy, budgeting, and reporting by establishing and maintaining enterprise planning and performance frameworks, encompassing annual and long-range strategic plans, budget and forecasting cycles, and disciplined reporting against agreed KPIs and investment objectives

• Embed compliance with Marriott policies and regulatory frameworks by integrating required standards and controls into the operating model, encompassing oversight across all properties and developments, adherence to legal and governance requirements, and proactive identification and mitigation of risk across jurisdictions.

• Own full P&L accountability including forecasting and capital planning by driving financial performance across the portfolio, encompassing revenue and profitability optimisation, budget development and reforecasting, and capital allocation decisions aligned to long-term asset value creation.

• Optimize a lean Joint Venture operating model by leveraging Marriott’s global and regional infrastructure, encompassing clear delineation of responsibilities across shared services, efficient resource allocation, and avoidance of unnecessary above-property duplication.

• Oversee design, technical standards, and sustainability integration by guiding concept development and execution across the portfolio, encompassing alignment to Lefay’s aesthetic and wellness positioning, technical and operational standards, and the integration of sustainability principles into both development and ongoing operations.

• Lead global stakeholder engagement with owners, developers, and partners by building and maintaining strategic relationships, encompassing alignment on brand expectations, performance outcomes, and long-term growth opportunities across the Lefay portfolio.

• Build and lead a high-performing leadership team across functions by defining required capabilities and structure, encompassing talent selection and development across brand, design, and finance, and embedding a culture aligned to Lefay’s values, standards, and performance expectations.

• Lead through influence within a complex matrix organisation by aligning cross-functional Marriott teams across regions and disciplines, encompassing collaboration, prioritisation, and delivery of shared objectives without direct line authority.

• Sustain strong relationships to drive long-term brand and financial performance by engaging consistently with owners, Joint Venture partners, and internal stakeholders, encompassing alignment to strategic priorities, investment objectives, and sustained brand integrity over time.

Additional Duties

• Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and compliance with Marriott policies.

• Champion cross-functional collaboration and team excellence, building a purpose-driven, peak performance culture across EMEA hotels and offices.
 Candidate Profile

Required

• 15+ years of senior leadership experience within upper‑luxury hospitality, lifestyle, or wellness‑adjacent brands, ideally in resort environments.

• Demonstrated credibility in the wellness space, paired with the judgment to operate as an enterprise business leader rather than a functional specialist.

• Proven success leading complex, multi‑entity or Joint Venture structures with Board‑level accountability.

• Extensive experience operating in multicultural, matrixed, and internationally regulated environments, including Europe.

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate market and business trends and translate strategy into large‑scale execution

• College degree required

Preferred

• Demonstrated strong strategic and commercial leadership, balancing long-term vision with disciplined execution and bringing deep financial acumen across P&L ownership, budgeting, forecasting, and capital planning.

• Operated effectively within complex, matrixed and Joint Venture environments, influencing outcomes without direct authority and aligning diverse stakeholders including Boards, owners, partners, and cross-functional teams.

• Exhibited credible and influential leadership, combining entrepreneurial brand stewardship with enterprise-level governance, supported by sound judgment, strong negotiation capability, and fact-based decision making.

• Built, led, and developed high-performing teams within lean organisational models, demonstrating the ability to prioritise, problem-solve, and deliver results in fast-paced, complex, and ambiguous environments.

• Demonstrated strong governance, risk, and compliance capability, operating with high integrity and accountability across multi-jurisdictional environments and leading transformation while maintaining operational stability.

• Built trusted relationships and aligned stakeholders globally, combining exceptional communication and partnership capability with a global mindset and a purpose-driven leadership style aligned to wellness values, resilience, and personal accountability.

• Graduate degree preferred, such as MBA or equivalent

Key Competencies

• Curious : Open to new ideas, seeks diverse viewpoints, and explores better ways of working.

• Courageous : Challenges norms, takes ownership, and leads change.

• Connected : Builds meaningful relationships and fosters collaboration across boundaries.

Enterprise Leadership & Peak Performance Capabilities

• Demonstrates strong commercial judgement and financial acumen, applying insight to drive sustainable results and enterprise value across a complex, multi brand and multimarket environment.

• Operates effectively in ambiguity, complexity, and change, maintaining clarity of direction and momentum while balancing competing priorities, commitments, and decision horizons.

• Thinks and acts with an enterprise mindset, prioritising end to end outcomes over functional or local optimisation and making disciplined trade-offs that protect brand integrity—particularly within luxury—while optimising enterprise value.

• Sets clear strategic direction and translates vision into priorities, commitments, and measurable outcomes through others, across a highly matrixed and geographically dispersed organisation.

• Builds strong, trust based stakeholder partnerships across senior regional leaders, owners and franchise partners, hotel leadership, brand and luxury platforms, and discipline teams; influences without authority and aligns diverse and sometimes competing interests toward shared enterprise outcomes.

• Leads inclusively across diverse cultures, geographies, and perspectives, demonstrating strong cultural fluency and situational awareness while reinforcing common purpose, values, and standards.

• Creates the conditions for sustained high performance, holding high standards of accountability while enabling focus, alignment, and continuous improvement at scale.

Leadership Approach & Expectations

• Leads through vision and values, ensuring decisions and behaviours consistently reflect organisational purpose, brand standards, and enterprise leadership expectations.

• Leads as a coach, adopting a coaching mindset that builds capability, strengthens judgement, and multiplies impact across teams, markets, and stakeholder groups.

• Embeds continuous, real time coaching and feedback, supporting individuals and teams to adapt, learn, and perform at their best in complex and evolving environments.

• Drives and sustains change, modelling resilience, composure, and confidence while removing barriers and accelerating progress across multiple geographies and stakeholder systems.

• Applies sound judgement and enterprise level decision making, integrating multiple perspectives, data, and contextual insight to navigate complexity and make effective trade-offs.

• Delivers results through others, setting clear expectations, establishing individual and collective accountability, and ensuring follow through across a matrixed operating model.

• Invests actively in talent and succession, developing current and future leaders capable of operating at scale and representing the enterprise across brands and markets.

Contribution to Peak Performance

• Champions a coaching led performance culture, where trust, learning, and honest dialogue enable sustained performance across diverse teams, brands, and geographies.

• Connects individual and team contributions to enterprise priorities and outcomes, reinforcing ownership, accountability, and clarity of purpose in a complex operating environment.

• Strengthens organisational capability by scaling impact through people, enabling leaders and teams to perform effectively without reliance on personal heroics.

• Shapes a culture of continuous improvement, resilience, and disciplined execution, ensuring the enterprise delivers consistent results while protecting brand integrity—particularly within luxury—and meeting commitments across markets.

Marriott International is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive, people-first culture. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, such as disability and veteran status, or any other basis covered under applicable law.

jobs.description:
eCHo Shiftleader (m/f/d)
 Is this you?
 • At least three years of practical work experience in the same or a related industry
 • You enjoy providing excellent service and are always on top of things
 • You organize your work in a structured manner and enjoy communicating in German and English; handling complex guest correspondence is essential. You creatively address guest issues and implement new ideas with great interest and a keen sense of guest needs.
 • You can effectively handle more challenging tasks even under stress and time pressure over the course of several days. You’re flexible and fit well into a young, dedicated team; you’re helpful and cooperative
 • For us, the guest is at the center of our business philosophy and actions—not just in mission statements on paper, but in practice and in our day-to-day work
 • Our team is extremely innovative and eager to experiment. If you also enjoy new things and challenges and approach them with curiosity and a drive to get things done, you’ll be a perfect fit for our team
 • You’re anything but ordinary!

Your Responsibilities

• Responsible for ensuring smooth service operations, guest service during your shift
 • Enforcing and meticulously maintaining the hotel’s internal standards regarding guest service
 • Taking reservations
 • Welcoming guests, seating them, providing guest service, and seeing them off
 • Knowledge of the entire food and beverage menu, as well as all services available at the hotel
 • Providing friendly, prompt, and clean service of food and beverages, as well as attentive and friendly guest service.
 • Training new employees

Here’s what we offer you

• A dynamic and young team of more than 200 bright minds who know how to have fun at work
 • In-house training
 • An open and transparent corporate culture that emphasizes the values of a passion for excellence, guest-centricity, and a spirit of innovation.
 • Fair and accurate time tracking
 • Solid benefits from an international hotel chain, such as employee rates for more than 9,000 hotels worldwide, affordable stays at the Zurich Marriott Hotel, and much more
 • Enjoyment at work
 • The position offers an attractive challenge with opportunities for growth and learning for the incumbent
 • A permanent position that requires independence and personal responsibility
 • You can expect a versatile role in a very lively and structured environment, progressive and dynamic employee policies, and the benefits of an international hotel group.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. JOB SUMMARY

Responsible for preparing all event documentation and coordinates with Sales, property departments and customer to ensure consistent, high level service throughout pre-event, event and post-event phases of property events. This position primarily handles events of average complexity. Ensures their property events have a seamless turnover from sales to service back to sales. Recognizes opportunities to maximize revenue opportunities by up-selling and offering enhancements to create outstanding events.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience
 • High school diploma or GED; experienced (1 – 2 years of experience) in the event management or related professional area.
 OR
 • 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; at least 1 year experience in the event management or related professional area required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Event Logistics and Operations
 • Ensures that events progress seamlessly by following established procedures, collaborating with other employees, and ensuring accuracy.
 • Greets customer during the event phase and hands-off to the Event Operations team for the execution of details.

Questa posizione gestisce principalmente eventi di media complessità. Assicura che i loro eventi di proprietà hanno un fatturato senza interruzioni dalle vendite al servizio di ritorno alle vendite. O

ATTIVITÀ DI LAVORO

Gestione della logistica e delle operazioni degli eventi
• Assicura che gli eventi progrediscano senza soluzione di continuità seguendo procedure consolidate, collaborando con altri dipendenti e garantendo precisione.
• Saluta il cliente durante la fase dell'evento e consegna al team Event Operations per l'esecuzione dei dettagli.
• Aderisce a tutti gli standard, le politiche e le procedure.
• Assicura la precisione di fatturazione e conduce le recensioni di bollette con i clienti prima di elaborare la bolletta finale.
• Gestisce i blocchi di stanza di gruppo e lo spazio di riunione per i gruppi assegnati di dimensioni medie e grandi.
• Identifica le sfide operative associate al suo gruppo e determina come lavorare al meglio con il personale e il cliente per risolvere queste sfide\ e/o sviluppare soluzioni alternative.
• Utilizza il suo giudizio per integrare le tendenze attuali nella gestione degli eventi e nella progettazione degli eventi.
• Agisce come collegamento tra venditore di campo e cliente durante il processo di evento (pre-evento, evento, post-evento).
• Partecipa alle ispezioni del sito del cliente e assiste con il processo di vendita se necessario.
• Esegui altri compiti assegnati per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali.
• Richiede feedback da parte dei dipartimenti di proprietà per identificare le aree di miglioramento per migliorare l'esperienza del pianificatore di eventi.

Garantire e fornire un servizio clienti eccezionale
• Fornisce un eccellente servizio clienti in tutta l'esperienza del cliente e incoraggia lo stesso da altri dipendenti.
• Incoraggia i dipendenti a fornire un servizio clienti eccellente.
• Imposta un esempio positivo per le relazioni degli ospiti.
• Coordina e comunica dettagli evento sia verbalmente che per iscritto alle operazioni del cliente e della proprietà.
• Rende la presenza nota al cliente in ogni momento durante questo processo.
• Supera le sue esperienze di cliente dal fatturato di file attraverso la fase post-evento fino al fatturato di ritorno alle vendite.
• Segui il post-evento del cliente.
• Risponde a e gestisce i problemi e i reclami degli ospiti.
• Utilizza giudizio personale e competenza per migliorare l'esperienza del cliente.
• Soggiorni disponibili per risolvere problemi e/o suggerire alternative alle disposizioni precedenti.
• Lavora per migliorare continuamente il servizio clienti integrando il feedback ottenuto e il giudizio personale nei piani di azione.
• Sottolinea la soddisfazione degli ospiti durante tutti gli incontri dipartimentali e si concentra sul miglioramento continuo.
• Interagisce con gli ospiti per ottenere un feedback sulla qualità del prodotto e sui livelli di servizio.
• Assicura ai dipendenti orari di comprendere le aspettative e i parametri per le attività degli eventi.

Team di gestione eventi leader
• Conduce riunioni formali pre- e post-evento come richiesto per rivedere / comunicare le esigenze del gruppo e feedback.
• Conduce riunioni formali di pre-evento e post-evento per gruppi assegnati in media a grandi dimensioni.
• Facilita vari incontri come percepisce necessario (Banquet Event Order meeting, block review, ecc).

Supporto e coordinamento con la funzione Vendite e Marketing
• Assiste nel processo di vendita e nella previsione delle entrate per i gruppi di clienti.
• Aggiorna prodotti e servizi in tutto il processo dell'evento.
• Previsioni gruppo camere da letto e ricavi eventi (catering e audio visual) per i suoi gruppi.

Gestione delle risorse umane Attività
• Recensioni commenti schede e risultati di soddisfazione degli ospiti con i dipendenti.
• Osserva i comportamenti di servizio dei dipendenti e fornisce feedback a persone e/o manager.
• Assiste nello sviluppo e nell'attuazione di piani d'azione correttivi.
• Prendere l'iniziativa di utilizzare la sua esperienza per migliorare le prestazioni di servizio secondo la sua valutazione del problema e la risoluzione.
• Lavora con il personale della proprietà e i clienti per affrontare le sfide operative associate al suo gruppo.
• Esegui altri compiti assegnati per soddisfare le esigenze aziendali.

A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile.

ZUSAMMENFASSUNG

Verantwortlich für die Vorbereitung aller Ereignisdokumentationen und koordiniert sich mit Vertrieb, Immobilienabteilungen und Kunden, um einen konsistenten, hochwertigen Service während der Vor-, Event- und Nach-Event-Phasen von Immobilienveranstaltungen zu gewährleisten. Diese Position behandelt in erster Linie Ereignisse von durchschnittlicher Komplexität. Stellt sicher, dass ihre Immobilienveranstaltungen einen nahtlosen Umsatz vom Verkauf über den Service bis zum Verkauf haben. Erkennt Möglichkeiten, Umsatzmöglichkeiten durch Up-Selling zu maximieren und Verbesserungen anzubieten, um herausragende Ereignisse zu schaffen.

KANDIDATPROFIL

Bildung und Erfahrung
• High-School-Diplom oder GED; erfahren (1 - 2 Jahre Erfahrung) im Event-Management oder verwandten beruflichen Bereich.
ODER
• 2-Jahres-Abschluss von einer akkreditierten Universität in Hotel- und Restaurantmanagement, Hospitality, Business Administration oder verwandten Hauptfach; mindestens 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Veranstaltungsmanagement oder verwandten beruflichen Bereich erforderlich.

KERNARBEITSTÄTIGKEITEN

Management von Event Logistik und Operations
• Stellt sicher, dass Ereignisse nahtlos voranschreiten, indem es etablierte Verfahren befolgt, mit anderen Mitarbeitern zusammenarbeitet und Genauigkeit gewährleistet.
• Grüßet den Kunden während der Veranstaltungsphase und die Übergabe an das Event Operations-Team zur Ausführung der Details.
• Befolgt alle Standards, Richtlinien und Verfahren.
• Stellt die Rechnungsgenauigkeit sicher und führt Rechnungsprüfungen mit den Kunden durch, bevor die endgültige Rechnung bearbeitet wird.
• Verwaltet Gruppenraumblöcke und Besprechungsräume für durchschnittliche bis große zugewiesene Gruppen.
• Identifiziert operative Herausforderungen, die mit seiner Gruppe verbunden sind, und bestimmt, wie man am besten mit dem Hauspersonal und dem Kunden zusammenarbeitet, um diese Herausforderungen zu lösen und / oder alternative Lösungen zu entwickeln.
• Nutzt sein Urteilsvermögen, um aktuelle Trends im Eventmanagement und Eventdesign zu integrieren.
• Funktioniert als Verbindung zwischen Außendienstmitarbeiter und Kunde während des gesamten Veranstaltungsprozesses (Pre-Event, Event, Post-Event).
• Beteiligt sich an Kundeninspektionen und unterstützt bei Bedarf den Verkaufsprozess.
• Führt andere Aufgaben aus, die zur Erfüllung der Geschäftsanforderungen zugewiesen wurden.
• Bittet um Feedback von den Immobilienabteilungen, um Verbesserungsbereiche zu identifizieren, um die Erfahrung des Eventplaners zu verbessern.

Sicherstellung und Bereitstellung eines außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice
• Bietet hervorragenden Kundenservice während des gesamten Kundenerlebnisses und fördert dasselbe von anderen Mitarbeitern.
• Ermöglicht es Mitarbeitern, einen hervorragenden Kundenservice zu bieten.
• Ein positives Beispiel für Gastbeziehungen.
• Koordiniert und kommuniziert Ereignisdetails sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich an den Kunden- und Immobilienbetrieb.
• Macht die Anwesenheit dem Kunden während dieses Prozesses jederzeit bekannt.
• Überwacht seine Kundenerfahrungen vom Dateiumsatz über die Post-Event-Phase bis zum Umsatz zurück zum Verkauf.
• Folgen Sie dem Kunden-Post-Event.
• Reagiert und behandelt Gästeprobleme und Beschwerden.
• Nutzt persönliches Urteilsvermögen und Fachwissen, um die Kundenerfahrung zu verbessern.
• Bleibt verfügbar, um Probleme zu lösen und / oder Alternativen zu früheren Arrangements vorzuschlagen.
• Arbeitet daran, den Kundenservice kontinuierlich zu verbessern, indem es erhaltenes Feedback und persönliches Urteilsvermögen in Aktionspläne integriert.
• Betont die Gästezufriedenheit bei allen Abteilungssitzungen und konzentriert sich auf die kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
• Interagiert mit Gästen, um Feedback zu Produktqualität und Service zu erhalten.
• Stellen Sie sicher, dass stündliche Mitarbeiter die Erwartungen und Parameter für Eventaktivitäten verstehen.

Führende Event Management Teams
• Führt formelle Treffen vor und nach der Veranstaltung durch, um die Bedürfnisse und das Feedback der Gruppe zu überprüfen / zu kommunizieren.
• Leitet formelle Pre-Event- und Post-Event-Meetings für durchschnittliche bis große zugewiesene Gruppen.
• Ermöglicht verschiedene Meetings, die er/sie für notwendig hält (Banquet Event Order Meeting, Block Review, etc.).

Unterstützung und Koordination mit der Vertriebs- und Marketingfunktion
• Unterstützt den Verkaufsprozess und die Umsatzprognose für Kundengruppen.
• Up-sells Produkte und Dienstleistungen während des gesamten Veranstaltungsprozesses.
• Prognostiziert gruppenschlafzimmer und veranstaltungseinnahmen (catering und audiovisuell) für seine gruppen.

Durchführung von Personalaktivitäten
• Bewertungen Kommentarkarten und Gästezufriedenheit Ergebnisse mit Mitarbeitern.
• Beobachtet das Serviceverhalten von Mitarbeitern und gibt Feedback an Einzelpersonen und / oder Manager.
• Hilft bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Korrekturmaßnahmenplänen.
• Ergreifen Sie die Initiative, seine Erfahrung zu nutzen, um die Serviceleistung entsprechend seiner Bewertung des Problems und der Lösung zu verbessern.
• Arbeitet mit dem Immobilienpersonal und den Kunden zusammen, um die mit seiner Gruppe verbundenen operativen Herausforderungen anzugehen.
• Führt andere Aufgaben aus, die zur Erfüllung der Geschäftsanforderungen zugewiesen wurden.

Bei Marriott International sind wir bestrebt, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein, alle willkommen zu heißen und Zugang zu Chancen zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv ein Umfeld, in dem die einzigartigen Hintergründe unserer Mitarbeiter geschätzt und gefeiert werden. Unsere größte Stärke liegt in der reichen Mischung aus Kultur, Talent und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, Veteranenstatus oder einer anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Grundlage.

RÉSUMÉ DE L'EMPLOI

Responsable de la préparation de toute la documentation de l'événement et de la coordination avec les ventes, les services immobiliers et les clients afin d'assurer un service cohérent et de haut niveau tout au long des phases pré-événement, événement et post-événement des événements immobiliers. Cette position s'occupe principalement des événements de complexité moyenne. S'assure que leurs événements immobiliers ont un chiffre d'affaires sans faille de la vente au service retour à la vente. Reconnaît les possibilités de maximiser les possibilités de revenus en vendant et en offrant des améliorations pour créer des événements exceptionnels.

PROFIL CANDIDAT

Éducation et expérience
• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou GED; expérimenté (1 – 2 ans d'expérience) dans la gestion d'événement ou le domaine professionnel connexe.
OU
• Diplôme de 2 ans d'une université accréditée en gestion d'hôtels et de restaurants, en hôtellerie, en administration des affaires ou d'une majeure connexe; au moins 1 an d'expérience dans la gestion d'événements ou le domaine professionnel connexe requis.

ACTIVITÉS DE BASE

Gestion de la logistique des événements et des opérations
• S'assure que les événements progressent sans heurt en suivant les procédures établies, en collaborant avec d'autres employés et en assurant l'exactitude.
• Salutations client pendant la phase de l'événement et mise à la disposition de l'équipe Event Operations pour l'exécution des détails.
• Adhére à toutes les normes, politiques et procédures.
• Assurer l'exactitude de la facturation et procéder à l'examen des factures avec les clients avant de traiter la facture finale.
• Gérer les blocs de salles de groupe et l'espace de réunion pour les groupes assignés de taille moyenne à grande.
• Identifier les défis opérationnels associés à son groupe et déterminer comment travailler au mieux avec le personnel de la propriété et le client pour résoudre ces défis\ et/ou développer d'autres solutions.
• Utilise son jugement pour intégrer les tendances actuelles dans la gestion des événements et la conception des événements.
• Agit comme liaison entre le vendeur sur le terrain et le client tout au long du processus d'événement (pré-événement, événement, post-événement).
• Participer aux inspections des sites clients et aider au processus de vente au besoin.
• Exécute d'autres fonctions qui sont assignées pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels.
• Sollicite la rétroaction des services immobiliers pour identifier les domaines à améliorer afin d'améliorer l'expérience du planificateur d'événements.

Assurer et fournir un service à la clientèle exceptionnel
• Offre un excellent service à la clientèle tout au long de l'expérience client et encourage les autres employés à le faire.
• Autorise les employés à fournir un excellent service à la clientèle.
• C'est un exemple positif pour les relations avec les invités.
• Coordonner et communiquer les détails de l'événement verbalement et par écrit au client et aux opérations immobilières.
• Fait connaître la présence du client à tout moment pendant ce processus.
• Supervise ses expériences clientes depuis le chiffre d'affaires des fichiers jusqu'à la phase post-événement jusqu'au retour au chiffre d'affaires.
• Suivi avec le client post-événement.
• Répondre et traiter les problèmes et les plaintes des clients.
• Utilise le jugement personnel et l'expertise pour améliorer l'expérience client.
• Reste disponible pour résoudre les problèmes et/ou proposer des solutions de rechange aux arrangements antérieurs.
• S'efforce d'améliorer continuellement le service à la clientèle en intégrant les commentaires obtenus et le jugement personnel dans les plans d'action.
• Souligne la satisfaction des clients lors de toutes les réunions ministérielles et met l'accent sur l'amélioration continue.
• Interagit avec les clients pour obtenir des commentaires sur la qualité des produits et les niveaux de service.
• S'assure que les employés horaires comprennent les attentes et les paramètres des activités de l'événement.

Équipes de gestion des événements
• Organiser des réunions officielles avant et après l'événement, au besoin, pour examiner et communiquer les besoins et les commentaires des groupes.
• Dirige les réunions officielles de pré-événement et de post-événement pour la moyenne aux grands groupes assignés.
• Facilite diverses réunions qu'il juge nécessaires (réunion de l'Ordre des événements de Bancet, examen en bloc, etc.).

Soutien et coordination avec la fonction Vente et Marketing
• Aide au processus de vente et à la prévision des revenus pour les groupes de clients.
• Les produits et services de mise à niveau tout au long du processus d'événement.
• Prévision des chambres de groupe et des revenus de l'événement pour ses groupes.

Activités liées aux ressources humaines
• Commentaires cartes de commentaires et résultats de satisfaction des clients avec les employés.
• Observe les comportements des employés en matière de services et fournit des commentaires aux particuliers et/ou aux gestionnaires.
• Aide à l'élaboration et à la mise en oeuvre de plans de mesures correctives.
• Prenez l'initiative d'utiliser son expérience pour améliorer le rendement du service selon son évaluation de la question et de la résolution.
• Travaille avec le personnel de l'immeuble et les clients pour relever les défis opérationnels associés à son groupe.
• Exécute d'autres fonctions qui sont assignées pour répondre aux besoins opérationnels.

À Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès aux possibilités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable.

Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language.
